Package game.items.food

Class FoodItem

java.lang.Object
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.GameEntity
edu.monash.fit2099.engine.items.Item
game.items.food.ConsumableItem
game.items.food.FoodItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
Printable, Consumable, Food, Processable
Direct Known Subclasses:
ParsnipItem, TomatoItem
public abstract class FoodItem extends ConsumableItem implements Food, Processable
Abstract base class for portable Items that can be consumed, used as animal food, and processed by a ProcessingFacility. Subclasses need only define their consume() effect and applyFeedingBonus() effect; ConsumeAction, FeedAction (when adjacent to a Feedable animal), and processing support are all provided automatically.
